dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Judging by your faces, it seems like you two still have some questions, yes?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Don't worry, you can be more casual with me. You've both helped me a great deal, so I'll tell you all I know.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, that's what we wanted to ask about.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We didn't take Bongo-Head with us previously for fairness's sake, so it wouldn't look like we were making ourselves the exception to the final decision.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's been some time since the tournament, though, so if we're able to communicate with our shroom buddies without having to rely on Wisdom Orbs...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We can keep Bongo-Head with us, can't we?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I have considered that as well, yes.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Supposing that you could find a place devoid of other residents or animals, this would be fine — in theory.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Although our Fungi friends are quite well-behaved, they might be angered if challenged by animals like Forest Boars.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we do have guests and animals in there at times, don't we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tubby would be really troubled if the Fungi were to get into fights with the other animals...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Perhaps we should ask Tubby first. Maybe she'd have some ideas!

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I'm also looking for new security measures, such as road signs or fences that have special spores on them that will cause Fungi to automatically remain within a specific area.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Perhaps we might be able to separate the living areas of the Fungi from that of other animals, thus preventing conflict.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: If something looks particularly promising, I'll inform you right away.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright then, let's all do our best!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thanks, Haniyyah!

choices.text: The Realm Within is quite spacious.
Tell me more about the Marvelous Jellies...

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Not to worry, I commissioned Ms. Najah from the Amurta to make these, and they serve as rations for the Fungi.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: The Jellies don't contain any medicinal components, only nutritional ones.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: We can use these Jellies to avoid the Fungi absorbing too many nutrients from the soil, which will prevent them from spoiling rainforest ecosystems.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: We can also add components to the Jellies according to the personalities of each Fungus to improve their mood.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, so you can do that too, huh? We can try to figure out Bongo-Head's favorite flavor, then?

choices.text: Do you want to give it a go, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nah! Floral Jellies and Marvelous Jellies all look pretty delicious, but Paimon's not so hard up that she'd need to eat food meant for Fungi!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, let's feed Bongo-Head and Kindlejoy some Marvelous Jellies later, shall we?

choices.text: I'd like to hear your review once you're done eating it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's got the same concerns, Haniyyah. Have you encountered any lack of Mora while taking care of the Fungi all this time?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Please do not worry.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I can secure food via fishing and hunting in the rainforest, and our shroom buddies can get the nutrients they need from the soil.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Other than clothes, daily necessities, and the funds required to make Marvelous Jellies, I don't really have many expenses to worry about.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I still have quite a large amount of savings left over from my work training Sumpter Beasts for merchant caravans. I've got enough for decades, even.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: W—Wow... So that's what it's like to be a professional beast tamer!

choices.text: If you need anything, just let us know.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I appreciate the sentiment. I promised to take good care of our shroom friends. As long as nothing goes awry, I won't add to your burdens.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, y'know what? That's kinda reassuring. When the opportunity comes around, let's treat Haniyyah to a nice meal plus some improved rations for our Fungi friends!

choices.text: We'll do our best to support you.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: No problem. I'll be here, and you're free to drop by any time.
